description: Remove all tags from a Zendesk organization. Use when you need to clear organization tags as part of cleanup or reorganization tasks. This action is irreversible — the tags will be permanently removed from the organization and cannot be recovered once deleted.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for removing organization tags.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization whose tags will be removed
organization_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk organization whose tags you want to delete. You can find this from a previous organization lookup or search result.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

inputSchema.title: DeleteOrganizationsTagsRequest

name: delete_organizations_tags

DeleteOrganizationsTagsResponse.description: Response containing the tags that were removed from the organization.

tags.description: An array of strings representing the tags that were removed from the organization
tags.title: Tags
